title: The MALL is Open: Exploring Shared Caches and Latency in AMD CDNA 3 GPUs
problem: Memory hierarchy characteristics of AMD CDNA 3 GPUs are not fully understood, hindering optimization
motivation: GPU applications need detailed latency profiles across cache hierarchy to optimize memory access patterns
method: They used pointer-chasing microbenchmarks—small focused tests where each memory access points to the next location, forcing the system to wait rather than parallelize requests—to measure data-retrieval speed from each GPU memory layer: sL1, L2, MALL (Infinity Cache), and HBM. They tested different configurations to understand how memory performance varies.
key_novelty: It characterizes memory access latency in AMD CDNA 3 GPUs, focusing on the MALL (Memory Attached Last Level cache) and revealing how NUMA effects—the variation in access speed based on data location—influence performance.
contributions: Memory latency profiles for MI300A, MI300X, MI250X
MALL contention and TLB behavior analysis
1.42x latency improvement via NPS4 NUMA partitioning
